topics.label: Introduction and lecture objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, the scope of the cancer lecture series, and the specific learning objectives regarding cancer causation.

topics.label: Drivers of cancer: intrinsic mutations, environmental exposures, and epidemiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the foundational causes of cancer by examining the relative contributions of intrinsic biological processes, environmental exposures, and epidemiological evidence across populations.

topics.label: Infectious pathogens in carcinogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how biological agents such as viruses and bacteria drive malignant transformation, focusing on the epidemiological and molecular evidence in Burkitt lymphoma.

topics.label: Chemical and physical mutagens and mechanisms of DNA damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how physical radiation and chemical carcinogens—both directly and through host metabolic bioactivation—cause DNA damage and mutational changes.

topics.label: Tumour initiation versus promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics distinguish mutational initiation from non-mutagenic promotion in carcinogenesis, illustrating how inflammatory and signalling agents drive clonal outgrowth.

topics.label: Host susceptibility and summary of carcinogenic mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how tissue developmental timing and host factors influence susceptibility to carcinogens, concluding with a synthesis of the mechanisms of cancer causation.

topics.label: Methodologies for identifying carcinogens and proving carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the genomic, epidemiological, in vivo, and in vitro experimental strategies used to detect carcinogens and assess their potency.

topics.label: Conclusion and risk-benefit considerations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with framing on the daily risk-benefit decisions surrounding carcinogen exposure alongside key summary takeaways.
